title: Verify: Palette module unit tests
summary: Unit tests for palette size, format, uniqueness and ramps
description: Write TDD-style tests for the palette module from the requirement.
acceptance_criteria: Tests assert at most 48 unique lowercase hex colours.
Tests assert warm and cool ramp names exist and do not overlap.
technical_constraints: Unit tests only; no browser or server.

steps.action: Create the file importing PALETTE, PALETTE_RAMPS, WARM_RAMPS, COOL_RAMPS from '../src/lib/palette'. Add test 'has at most 48 unique hex colours' asserting PALETTE.length <= 48, new Set(PALETTE).size === PALETTE.length, and every entry matches /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/palette.test.ts

steps.action: Add test 'names warm and cool ramps' asserting every name in WARM_RAMPS and COOL_RAMPS is a key of PALETTE_RAMPS, the two lists share no name, and together they cover Object.keys(PALETTE_RAMPS).
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/palette.test.ts
